items.key: This stand is the audited irrigated geometry. Groundnuts need sandy, well-drained soil and a long frost-free growing season.
items.draft: Esi sithuba siyigeometri ehlolwe ngokunkcenkceshelwa. I-groundnuts zifuna umhlaba oneentlabathi nodlulisa amanzi kakuhle kunye nexesha elide lokukhula elingenaqabaka.
items.backtranslation: This spacing is geometry checked by irrigation. Groundnuts need sandy, well-draining soil...
items.problem: "audited irrigated geometry" garbled to "geometry checked by (being) irrigated"; the irrigated-condition meaning is lost.
items.corrected: Olu lungiselelo lwezityalo yigeometri ehloliwe kwiimeko zokunkcenkceshelwa. I-groundnuts zifuna umhlaba oneentlabathi nodlulisa amanzi kakuhle kunye nexesha elide lokukhula elingenaqabaka.

items.key: Unshelled (in-shell) pods dried to in-shell moisture ~10% or less, stored in gunny bags, mud bins, baskets or a ventilated dry room, protected from pests and damp.
items.draft: Iipodi ezingaxobulwanga (in-shell) ezomiswe zaya kumswakama we-in-shell ongama-~10% okanye ngaphantsi, zigcinwe kwiingxowa zegunny, kwiibhini zodaka, kwiingobozi okanye egumbini elomileyo elifumana umoya, zikhuselwe kwizinambuzane nakumswakama.
items.backtranslation: ...stored in gunny bags, mud bins, [iingobozi - unclear word], or a dry ventilated room...
items.problem: "baskets" rendered as "iingobozi", an uncertain/possibly regional word (not attested elsewhere in the locale); replaced with plain loanword for baskets. Coordinator: kept "iingobozi" (ingobozi is the isiXhosa word for basket); not applied.
items.corrected: Iipodi ezingaxobulwanga (in-shell) ezomiswe zaya kumswakama we-in-shell ongama-~10% okanye ngaphantsi, zigcinwe kwiingxowa zegunny, kwiibhini zodaka, kwiibhasikithi okanye egumbini elomileyo elifumana umoya, zikhuselwe kwizinambuzane nakumswakama.

items.key: Grown and eaten as a fresh vegetable, unlike field maize — the dossier's own food-group is fruiting vegetable, not staple grain, so it is kept there rather than lumped with maize despite the shared species. Tender to frost like maize.
items.draft: Ikhuliswa kwaye idliwa njengemifuno emitsha, ngokungafaniyo ne-maize yentsimi — iqela lokutya ledosi ngokwalo yimifuno eqhamayo, hayi iinkozo eziyisiseko, ngoko igcinwe apho endaweni yokudityaniswa ne-maize nangona ilolu hlobo lufanayo. Ithambile kwiqabaka njenge-maize.
items.backtranslation: ...the food group of the dose itself is fruiting vegetables, not staple grain...
items.problem: "dossier" (the crop's own catalogue file) mistranslated as "dose" (idosi).
items.corrected: Ikhuliswa kwaye idliwa njengemifuno emitsha, ngokungafaniyo ne-maize yentsimi — iqela lokutya elibhalwe kwifayile yesityalo ngokwalo yimifuno eqhamayo, hayi iinkozo eziyisiseko, ngoko igcinwe apho endaweni yokudityaniswa ne-maize nangona ilolu hlobo lufanayo. Ithambile kwiqabaka njenge-maize.
